mentions.name: Rio
mentions.description: Rio is a modern TypeScript HTTP client for Node.js 24+, Deno and Bun, built on the native fetch API and fully type-safe from request to response. Still a work in progress, it aims to be an alternative to fetch, Axios, and ky.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on Rio[0], a modern TypeScript HTTP client for Node.js 24+, Deno and Bun. It's built on the native `fetch` API and fully type-safe from request to response. It's still very much a work in progress but I'm working towards an alternative to fetch/Axios/ky I wish I had.
